profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the telecommunications, airlines, and insurance industry. Skilled in PostgreSQL, x86 Assembly, Node.js, C++, Rust and Linux. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer Science from Florida International University.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer working in the EVs, Digital & Design (EVDD) team at Ford. I help write and maintain code for the software update (OTA) side of things.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: I am doing research and development for the FLX Shop & Price. With focus on the pricing engine. I am developing in C++.

positions.title: System Developer
positions.description: As a System Developer I am responsible for the execution and implementation of complex management solutions for the most advanced telecom environments in the world. I thrive on the crossroads of telecom and software. I embrace new technologies, innovation and creativity.

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description: As a research assistant I provided help with running the model (more information about the model can be found here: https://www4.cis.fiu.edu/hurricaneloss/html/model001.html#1) and developing software that helped with the process. I contributed to a research paper during the time of my employment.

company.name: Florida International University: Distributed Multimedia Information Systems Lab

publications.title: Integrated Execution Framework for Catastrophe Modeling
